_meta.base: Evolution 2nd edition (North Star Games, 2017): 129 cards, 17 traits. Data in js/cards.js.
_meta.notation: food = number printed in the card's corner (plant food added to the Watering Hole when played face-down as a food card). Climate cards also carry climate icons: 'S' = sun count, 'C' = snowflake count, so climate {S:3} means 3 suns.
_meta.confidence: Labels (cross-check pass 2026-11-09): 'exact, 2 sources' = two independently made images/documents agree; 'exact, 1 source' = read clearly from one card scan (several TTS mods reuse the SAME byte-identical image, which counts as one source); 'missing' = not found. Older labels 'exact'/'partial' map to these as stated per card.

flight.name: Evolution: Flight
flight.food_confidence: exact, 1 source for the full per-copy lists (one card scan, reused by 6 TTS mods). Spot-checked against the official 2015 rulebook's sample card pictures: Brood Parasite 5, Dive-Bomb 4 and 2, Camouflage -1, Good Eyesight -1, Nesting 0, Seed Dispersal 1 and -1 all appear in the lists below (agree, but don't prove the full sets). The 6 extra Carnivores (-4,-3,-2,-1,7,8): exact, 1 source.
flight.components: 34 trait cards + 14 event cards (48 deck cards), 12 Flight trait cards (cardboard, kept out of the deck), 12 Avian species boards, 1 Cliff board

cards.effect: Land species: no effect. Avian species: before food cards are revealed, if you have another Avian species, gain 1 population and take 1 plant or meat food from the bank.
A Carnivore must have Good Eyesight to attack this species.
Carnivore: negates Camouflage. Non-Carnivore: before food cards are revealed, take 2 plant food from the Watering Hole.
Each time this species gains population: a Land species takes 1 plant food from the bank or Watering Hole; an Avian species takes 2 meat food from the bank.
Same as base Carnivore (these are extra copies).

Discard from hand during Play Cards, after traits are revealed, to feed one of your Avian species, then draw a card. A Carnivore attacks; a Non-Carnivore takes 2 plant food from the Watering Hole, the Cliff or the bank.
cards.confidence: exact (the bank part reasoned from card text crop)

cards.effect: Discard from hand during Play Cards, after traits are revealed: add plant food to the Watering Hole equal to the number of Avian species in play, then draw a card.

non_deck_cards.name: Flight
non_deck_cards.kind: species trait (cardboard, starts on every new Avian species)
non_deck_cards.effect: Only a Carnivore with Flight can attack this species. Non-Carnivore may feed from the Cliff. A Carnivore with Flight may discard a card to negate Warning Call, Symbiosis or Climbing on its next attack.
non_deck_cards.confidence: exact, 2 sources (mod card image + official rulebook picture): text matches and the card has NO food number

boards: 12 Avian species boards (body size track max 3)
Cliff board (second food source, Avians only)
rules: Shuffle the 34 new traits + 14 events into the base deck. Remove 40 cards from the deck and set them aside; when the deck runs out, use these 40 cards for the final round INSTEAD of shuffling the discard pile. (exact, 2 sources: official 2015 rulebook Set-Up step 3 + End of Game, and ultraboardgames summary)
Brood Parasite's population gain triggers Cooperation, Nesting and Foraging; Brood Parasite on a Land species still scores 1 point (official rulebook reference section).

Nesting: a Land species takes 1 plant food from the Watering Hole or the bank per population gained (triggers Cooperation and Foraging); an Avian takes 2 meat from the bank (triggers Cooperation, not Scavenger). If an Avian's body size rises after a population gain, move food from population slots to upkeep slots (official rulebook).
Dive-Bomb / Seed Dispersal: if the card drawn is another event, it may also be played immediately (official rulebook).
New Avian species costs 2 cards discarded (a Land species costs 1). Starts at population 1, body size 1, with a Flight card in one of its 3 trait slots.
Avian max body size 3.
Avian upkeep: at the start of its feeding, an Avian must first eat food equal to its body size; that upkeep food is returned to the bank, not scored. Then it feeds population normally.

Flight occupies a trait slot, scores 1 point, can be negated by Intelligence. If Flight is replaced/discarded the species becomes a Land species (flip the board). A Land species can never become Avian.

Cliff: when food cards are revealed, add plant food to the Cliff equal to the number of players. Only Avian non-Carnivores may take from it; a species may not take from both Cliff and Watering Hole in the same feeding turn. Cooperation/Foraging still trigger.
Event cards are discarded from hand for an immediate effect; they are never played as traits.
Simultaneous triggers resolve in turn order starting with the first player.
flight.combines_with: Base. Promo Pack II/I traits fine. Do NOT combine with Climate (designers' guidance) or with the Plant micro-expansion (stated incompatible).

climate.name: Evolution: Climate (standalone) / Climate Conversion Pack
climate.type: standalone game (2016); the Conversion Pack turns a base Evolution into Climate
climate.components: 177 trait cards (= 91 unchanged base cards + 86 conversion-kit cards), 30 climate event cards (15 cold, 15 hot), climate board + marker, 20 species boards, 6 food bags. Conversion Pack = the 86 cards + 30 events + board + marker.
climate.deck_build: Take the base 2nd-edition deck, REMOVE all Ambush, Burrowing, Defensive Herding and Carnivore cards, keep the other 91 (no climate icons, same food numbers), and ADD the 86 kit cards below.

cards.effect: Base Ambush; also ignores one defensive trait when attacking a Migratory species (Climate text).
Base Burrowing; also prevents 1 heat and 1 cold population loss.
Base Defensive Herding; also prevents 1 cold loss.
Base Carnivore.
+2 body size when this species is attacked (defence only). Prevents 3 heat loss.
cards.confidence: exact (complete in mod 2425; mod 937 missing 3 faces)

cards.effect: Prevents 4 cold loss. In the three hottest zones (Tropical, Hot, Scorching) the species suffers +1 extra heat loss.
When checking hunger, may ignore up to 2 unfed population; they are not lost to starvation. With Burrowing, protected when all but 2 are fed. Prevents 1 cold loss.
After all feeding, if the Watering Hole is empty, take up to 2 plant food from the bank. Prevents 1 heat and 1 cold loss.
A Carnivore must discard a card from hand before each attack on this species. Prevents 1 heat loss.

Before each of your feeding turns, this species takes a free feeding if no Carnivore in play could attack it (Intelligence counts only if its owner has enough cards; fully fed Carnivores can't attack). Prevents 1 heat loss.

climate_board.confidence: exact (read from board image, mod 2425 Climate Board front/back)

events.note: Each event card is placed under the climate zone named on it; it triggers only when the marker is in that zone. Heat Wave / Cold Snap REPLACE the zone's own effects that round with the card's sizes, loss and leaf.
events.setup_rule: Setup: shuffle the 15 Cold events (bottom-left of the board) and the 15 Hot events (bottom-right) as two decks; draw the top card of each and place it face-up under the zone named on it. After an event triggers, put it at the bottom of its own deck (unless the card says otherwise, e.g. Glacial Thaw) and draw a replacement from the same deck; the new card can't trigger until next round. There are always 2 face-up events (1 cold, 1 hot) and only 1 event can trigger per round. (exact, 1 source: official Climate rulebook pp. 4 and 8)
events.count: 30 cards, each listed individually below (15 cold + 15 hot). Card counts by type: Cold deck = Meteorite 1, Volcanic Eruption 3, Glacial Thaw 2, Heat Wave 5, Cold Snap 4. Hot deck = Meteorite 1, Volcanic Eruption 2, Desertification 2, Wildfire 3, Heat Wave 4, Cold Snap 3.

effects.Meteorite: From now until game end, no positive plant food is added (negative totals still remove food).
effects.Volcanic Eruption: At the end of Feeding, move the marker to the named zone.
effects.Glacial Thaw: Place the card on the Watering Hole; next round it adds 3 suns to the icon count.
effects.Desertification: No positive plant food this round; every species with body size > 1 loses 1 body size.
effects.Wildfire: Every species without Burrowing loses 1 population (not climate loss, so climate traits don't prevent it). This round's plant food is set aside and added before the next Deal.
effects.Heat Wave / Cold Snap: Replace the current zone's effect this round with the card's body sizes, loss and leaf value.

events.confidence: exact, 2 sources: all 30 cards (zone, name, body sizes, icons, leaf, target zone) agree between mod 937 sheets 669/670 and the separately made mod 2425085506 sheets 1/3 (5x3 grid, different file). Effect texts also match the official Climate rulebook reference section. Card wording: Meteorite 'Don't add Food to the Watering Hole this round... and for the rest of the game!' (rulebook: negative totals still remove food); Wildfire '-1 Population for species without Burrowing. Don't add Food to the Watering Hole until after the feeding phase is over.'

rules: Phases: Deal, Select Food, Play Cards, Modify Environment, Feeding.
Deal 4 cards + 1 per species (base is 3 + 1).
Max 4 traits per species (3 in a 2-player game).

Deck size by players: 2p remove half the deck; 3p remove 60 cards; 4p remove 30; 5-6p remove none. Removed cards become the new deck when the deck runs out (5-6p: shuffle the discards instead). The game ends as in base when the deck runs out the second time / final round.
After Play Cards, a player may put any number of hand cards on the bottom of the deck and draw that many.

Modify Environment order: (1) traits that trigger 'before food cards are revealed' (leaf-icon traits such as Long Neck, Fertile) trigger; (2) reveal food cards; count suns vs snowflakes on revealed food cards; marker moves 1 zone toward the larger side (tie: stays); (3) trigger the event at the marker's zone, if any; (4) climate population loss, all species at once, protective traits stack; (5) plant food = sum of food numbers + zone leaf value (negative removes food from the Watering Hole); (6) replace the triggered event.
Climate loss: a species whose body size is listed for the zone loses that many population, minus its heat/cold prevention.
Variant: play without events. Quick Play recommended at 6 players.
Scoring and ties as base.
climate.combines_with: Base cards (via the conversion pack). Promo traits allowed but don't reduce the number of climate-icon cards. Plant micro-expansion has a Climate mode. Not designed to combine with Flight.
sources: Steam Workshop mod 2425085506 sheets 4/4959, climate board image

the_beginning.name: Evolution: The Beginning
the_beginning.type: separate standalone family game (simplified), not an expansion
the_beginning.components: 88 cards, 234 food tokens, 1 Watering Hole, 5 food bags. Any card can be a species/population (face-down) or a trait (face-up). No food numbers on cards.
rules: Players take turns (not simultaneous). Turn: Gather, Adapt, Eat, Score.
Gather: put 2 food on the Watering Hole, take a deck card face-down as a new species (pop 1), draw 3.
Adapt: any number of times: new species (card face-down), +1 population (card face-down on a species), add trait (face-up, max 3, no duplicates), save cards; may discard traits.

Eat: each population eats 1; non-Carnivores must eat from the Watering Hole as much as they can. Carnivores attack a species whose defensive traits (Burrowing/Flight/Nocturnal/Speed) they all share; remove 1 population; Carnivore gets 2 food from the supply; every Scavenger gets 1. Carnivores must keep attacking until fed or no targets (may have to attack own species).
Defensive Horns: attacker loses 1 population before getting food.
Unfed population starves at end of turn. Extinct species: discard traits, draw that many cards.
End: when deck runs out, shuffle discards, play until everyone has had equal turns. Score 1 per food, per card on the table, per card in hand.
